Reach without capture

Your reels travel, then the viewer is gone

A reel can reach 120k people. The ones who loved it but aren’t ready for a call have nowhere to go next, so most of that reach never turns into a name on your list.

Big jump

From a book to 1:1 in one step

Between a best-seller and personal coaching there is no hour where people experience you teaching live. That hour is usually what turns a reader into a client.

Unfiltered calls

Clarity calls do the sorting

With no application in front of the calendar, your time goes on calls with people who are curious, not ready. Thirty-five years of experience deserves a filter.

You already have the audience, the book and the coaching. What’s missing is one free, always-on class that captures the reach, sells the book and shows you who is ready for 1:1.

*The 95% figure is an industry estimate, not your data.

My recommendation

A free, ads-fed masterclass between your reels and your clarity calls

Everything you’ve built stays. The free class becomes the front door: it teaches your approach to connecting with Self, offers Karma & Diamonds on the thank-you page, and hands the people ready for more an application for 1:1 coaching.

Captures the reach

Every reel and every ad points to one free class. Every seat is an email you keep, so a viewer becomes someone you can follow up with.

Sells the book on autopilot

Right after signing up, people are offered Karma & Diamonds with a guided meditation. Your existing products start paying for the ads that fill the class.

Filters the clarity calls

People who watch, stay and apply are the ones ready to invest. The application tells you what they want to change and their timing before you give them an hour.

The 95%*

Curious, not ready for 1:1 yet

They take the free class, many buy the Karma & Diamonds bundle, and everyone joins your list for your meditations, albums and events.

The qualified 5%

Ready for personal coaching

They attend, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The pre-call emails prepare them, so your clarity calls are with people who already know how you work.

Does this sound familiar?

Doing everything right on the outside. Still searching on the inside.

Here’s what you’ll learn

What “connecting to Self” really means

An exercise to separate what you truly want from what you think you should want.

Script 1 · “The outside and the inside”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“What if the success you’re chasing on the outside starts somewhere else?”

Body

“I’ve practised and taught yoga and self-development for over 35 years. The pattern I see again and again: people work hard on everything outside, and almost nothing inside. When you connect to Self first, your choices change, and so does where they lead.”

CTA

“I’m teaching how in a free live masterclass. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: Smita to camera in royal blue, soft violet and pink light behind, gold captions.

Script 2 · “Ten minutes”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You don’t need an hour to meditate. You need ten honest minutes.”

Body

“Most people give up on inner work because they think it takes too long. In my free class I’ll walk you through a ten-minute morning practice you can do before you even pick up your phone.”

CTA

“The Inner Diamond Masterclass is free and live. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: Smita seated, timer graphic counting from 10:00, on-screen text “10 minutes”.

Script 3 · “Karma and diamonds”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why did I call my book Karma & Diamonds?”

Body

“Because a diamond is formed by pressure, over time. Our choices work the same way. Small actions, repeated every day, shape who we become. In my free class I’ll show you how to choose them on purpose.”

CTA

“Join my free live masterclass. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: Smita holding Karma & Diamonds, cut to close-up, on-screen text “small choices, every day”.
